definition: One patient identified by the local subject_id.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE patients(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gender IN ('F','M')))

definition: A distinct hospital stay of one patient; a patient can have multiple stays.
row_grain: One row per hospital admission, identified by hadm_id.
declared_checks: CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime); CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime)
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE admissions(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id), edregtime TEXT, admittime TEXT NOT NULL, discharge_authorized_at TEXT, dischtime TEXT, CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime), CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime))

definition: Optional supplementary information for the patient identified by patients.subject_id. Both tables use the same local patient identifier; no SQL foreign key is declared between them.
row_grain: At most one supplementary profile per patient.
logical_relationships: subject_id -> patients(subject_id): Documented identifier relationship; no declared SQL foreign key
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE patient_profile(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, profile_verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Optional signed-summary information for the hospital admission identified by admissions.hadm_id.
row_grain: At most one signed-summary record per hospital admission.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE admission_detail(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), discharge_summary_signed_at TEXT NOT NULL, summary_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(summary_status='SIGNED'))

definition: A laboratory request associated with one hospital admission. Its identifiers are local to laboratory orders and do not identify medication or procedure requests.
row_grain: One row per laboratory order; multiple measurements may belong to it.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE lab_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), specimen_received_at TEXT, results_verified_at TEXT)

definition: A medication request associated with one hospital admission. Its identifiers are local to medication orders and do not identify laboratory or procedure requests.
row_grain: One row per medication order; multiple dose records may belong to it.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE medication_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), medication TEXT NOT NULL, dispensed_at TEXT, stopped_at TEXT)

definition: A procedure request associated with one hospital admission. Its identifiers are local to procedure orders and do not identify laboratory or medication requests.
row_grain: One row per procedure order; multiple execution episodes may belong to it.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE procedure_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL, preparation_completed_at TEXT)

definition: A recorded action on one laboratory, medication or procedure order. Exactly one of the three order-reference columns is populated.
row_grain: One row per order-action occurrence, including repeated reviews.
foreign_keys: lab_order_id -> lab_order.order_id; medication_order_id -> medication_order.order_id; procedure_order_id -> procedure_order.order_id
declared_checks: CHECK((lab_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(medication_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(procedure_order_id IS NOT NULL)=1)
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE order_history(history_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, lab_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), medication_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), procedure_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('ENTERED','REVIEWED','CANCELLED')), occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK((lab_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(medication_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(procedure_order_id IS NOT NULL)=1))

definition: A measurement belonging to one laboratory order, with separate charting and result-availability times.
row_grain: One row per measurement occurrence; repeated measurements have different labevent_id values.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE labevents(labevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), itemid INTEGER NOT NULL, charttime TEXT NOT NULL, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, valuenum REAL, valueuom TEXT, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: An individual dose record documenting administration or omission for one medication order.
row_grain: One row per administration or omission occurrence.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE emar(emar_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), charttime TEXT NOT NULL, event_txt TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_txt IN ('Administered','Not Given')), storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: An execution episode of a procedure order with its own actual start, optional end and documentation time.
row_grain: One row per execution episode, including repeat episodes.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE procedureevents(procedureevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), starttime TEXT NOT NULL, endtime TEXT, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(endtime IS NULL OR starttime<=endtime))
